About.heading: About
About.lead: I build software for systems where reliability, scalability and maintainability matter.
About.body: Backend-focused Software Engineer working in the Java ecosystem across distributed, microservice and event-driven environments. My experience is grounded in financial and enterprise production software, with the flexibility to contribute to modern frontend interfaces when needed.
